text: The Red Cat and the Rat Illustrate the story here: The red cat sees a rat. The rat runs. The red cat runs to get the rat. The rat is fast. The red cat is not as fast. The rat runs to a raft. The rat got on the raft. The red cat did not fit on the raft. The rat got rid of the red cat.
paragraphs: The Red Cat and the Rat

The rat runs to a raft. The rat got on the raft. The red cat did not fit on the raft. The rat got rid of the red cat.
